name: image-accordion
title: Image Accordion
description: A row of image panels where one is wide and the rest are slim. The open panel follows hover, focus or click and reveals its title.

props.name: items
props.description: The panels, left to right: { id, title, description?, media }.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Index of the panel that is open first.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What opens a panel. Focus and click always work.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the strip in pixels.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the panels take to resize.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new index when a different panel opens.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
